items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to switch a customer session to another customer account, gaining access to private customer data.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (B2B) leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical vulnerability allowing unrestricted file upload, which could lead to privilege escalation by uploading malicious files to the server.

items.title: Improper Output Encoding leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A critical vulnerability due to improper output encoding that could result in arbitrary code execution through targeted attacks via webhooks.

items.title: Stored XSS leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could lead to privilege escalation by injecting malicious scripts in the backend.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability that could circumvent default system rules and bypass security features.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Unauthorized Access to Resources
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability that could lead to unauthorized access to sensitive resources.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Auth Bypass)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting multiple versions of Adobe Commerce, allowing a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento's REST API
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique to bypass validation. Adobe released a fix in Magento 2.4.9 on May 12th.
